notes.title: 4 Kingdoms Supremacy - Rework
notes.notes:
Complete rework of chapters 1 and 2
- Luna and Astrid have been changed to better models
- All scenes with them have also been reworked and rendered again from scratch, some receiving new animations and others receiving specific adjustments for improvement
- The breast and nipple models have been replaced by better models for all the girls
- New scenes and dialogues added to the first and second chapters
- You can now do a short Free Roam through the Viking Village during the first chapter
- The training with the Captain in the second chapter has been expanded
- The labyrinth and the minotaur city have also been expanded
- You now have the option of having the minotaurs as allies or not
- You can now follow Luna and Astrid's route simultaneously, being able to see scenes from one without interrupting the other's route in the same save
- The ways to get the scenes with them have also been changed and there are triggers necessary for you to follow the romance with both of them (PS: Luna's personality has been changed and she will be much naughtier in this version)
- The scene gallery has been changed and readjusted to reflect the new animations that have been added.

The order of many events has been changed, and several additional scenes and dialogues have been placed between previously existing scenes to further flesh out the story. The original plot has not been changed, only improved and expanded.
Due to all these changes, I strongly suggest that you start a new save from scratch so that you don't miss any new scenes or triggers that are necessary to continue the game. I know it's annoying to have to start over, but there's a lot of additional content for you to explore in a new run.
